items.title: Caught in 4K: The Gentlemen Files
items.content: A Russian-speaking affiliate of the Gentlemen ransomware group, identifying as Azazel, compromised over two dozen organizations across six countries while simultaneously betraying the RaaS operator. The threat actor deployed independent leak site LEAKNED, keeping all extortion proceeds. Attack chains primarily exploited CI/CD secrets from GitLab instances, with one deep compromise involving an AI... This pulse includes 1 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Logistics, Finance, Healthcare.

items.title: A STUNning Disguise: Cling Malware Masquerades as Google
items.content: A sophisticated IoT botnet dubbed Cling has been discovered exploiting vulnerable internet-exposed devices through CVE-2021-35394 and other command-injection flaws. The malware distinguishes itself by abusing STUN protocol traffic and public STUN infrastructure for command-and-control communications, making malicious activity appear as legitimate NAT-traversal behavior. items.title: Inside a malicious Claude Code-branded extension and its persistent SSH backdoor
items.content: A compromised version of the Claude Code extension (anthropic.claude-code, versions 2.1.313 and 2.1.312) was distributed through the Cursor extension marketplace from October 29, 2026, between 2:27 AM and 1:35 PM PDT. The malicious extension contained injected JavaScript that executed during module loading to establish persistent backdoor access. The loader collected host reconnaissance data,... This pulse includes 4 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: Trojan:MacOS/SmtShellMal.A, Trojan:JS/CredTheft.MS!MTB, Trojan:MacOS/MalPlistSysmond.A.

items.title: Fake-download campaign uses trojanized installers to deliver monetization payloads
items.content: Microsoft Threat Intelligence identified an evolving campaign targeting users searching for cracked commercial software, free games, activators, and unofficial utilities. The operation uses trojanized Inno Setup-style installers to distribute multiple monetized software payloads through a per-offer callback and status-tracking system.
